blocks.title: Why Consider Liquid-Filled Hard Capsules Over Softgels?
blocks.subtitle:
Different Technology. Different Product Possibilities.

Liquid-filled hard capsules and softgels can both accommodate liquid or semi-liquid formulations, but they use different capsule systems and manufacturing approaches. For businesses developing differentiated healthcare products, the choice can come down to formulation requirements, product positioning, manufacturing considerations and the desired dosage-form experience.

Multiple Pellets. One Precisely Designed Capsule.
